name: Advanced Age Verification Popup
author: Yeasin

sections.description:
Advanced Age Verification Popup is a powerful, lightweight, and heavily customizable WordPress plugin that allows you to add a modern age verification popup to your website. Ideal for websites selling age-restricted products like vaping supplies, alcohol, CBD, or adult content.

Premium Key Features (100% Free)

  • 100% Cache Friendly: Works flawlessly out-of-the-box with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, W3 Total Cache, and Cloudflare. No complex configuration needed!
  • Multilingual Support (WPML/Polylang): Fully integrated with WPML and Polylang! Translate your custom titles, subtitles, and button text directly from your String Translation dashboard.
  • Dynamic Minimum Age: Set the required age to 18, 21, or any custom number.
  • SEO Friendly (Crawler Bypass): Automatically detects Googlebot, Bing, etc., and hides the popup so your SEO ranking is never negatively impacted!
  • Multiple Verification Methods: Choose between Yes/No Buttons, Date of Birth (Calendar), or Both.
  • Custom Color Picker: Fully customize the background, buttons, and text colors from the backend to match your theme.
  • “Remember Me” Consent: Let users opt-in to a 30-day cookie, or opt-out for a single-session cookie.
  • Bypass Logged-in Users: Avoid annoying administrators by hiding the popup when logged in.
  • Modern UI: Features a sleek glassmorphism aesthetic with smooth CSS animations.
  • Custom Logo Upload: Use the native WordPress Media Uploader.
  • Redirect Underage Users: Send failed verifications to a custom URL.
  • WooCommerce Compatible: Works perfectly on all pages and is highly responsive for mobile devices.

🚀 Pro Features Available Now!

Take your store to the next level. Get maximum legal protection, fraud prevention, and seamless WooCommerce conversion tools.

  • 📍 Geo-Location & Country Rules:

    • Targeted Display: Only show the age gate to visitors from specific countries.
    • Dynamic Country Rules: Automatically require different minimum ages based on the user’s region (e.g., US:21, UK:18).
    • Strict Geo-Fencing: Instantly block or redirect users attempting to access from illegal states or restricted countries.

  • 🛒 WooCommerce Integrations:

    • Display Scope: Lock the entire site, protect specific product categories, or restrict only the checkout form.
    • Conversion Soft Gating: Let customers browse freely; only show the age gate when they click “Add to Cart”.
    • B2B & Shipping Locks: Auto-bypass verified wholesalers and automatically tag WooCommerce orders for Adult Signature delivery.

  • 🎨 Design & Themes:

    • Pre-made Aesthetics: Apply 1-click premium templates designed for Vape, Wine, and CBD industries.
    • Visual Controls: Customize Google Fonts, border radius, frosted glass blur intensity, and entrance animations.
    • Media Backgrounds: Add highly immersive full-screen background images or silent, looping MP4 videos.

  • 🔒 Security & Lockout:

    • Strict Anti-Bypass: Stop teenagers from hitting “Back” to fake their age. Cache-proof IP bans physically block underage users.
    • Fraud Protection: Actively block Inspect Element tools and enforce a maximum realistic age limit (e.g., block 100+ year olds).
    • Bot CAPTCHA: Automatically secure the gate against spam bots using silent Cloudflare Turnstile or reCAPTCHA v3.

  • 🆔 Identity Moderation (KYC):

    • Document Uploads: Enforce strict compliance by requiring users to securely upload a Photo ID alongside their Date of Birth.
    • Moderation Queue: Review, approve, or instantly auto-shred submissions from a beautifully organized backend Lightbox.
    • AI Auto-Verification: Connect Stripe Identity or Veriff API keys to instantly scan faces and auto-approve documents.

  • 📈 Analytics Dashboard:

    • Traffic & Trends: Visualize your views, passes, and drop-off rates on interactive Chart.js graphs across custom date ranges.
    • Deep Diagnostics: View performance breakdowns by Device (Mobile vs. Desktop) and pinpoint geographic drop-offs.
    • Marketing Pixels: Automatically push age_gate_passed conversion events directly to Google Analytics 4 and Meta Pixel.

Use Cases

  • Vape and E-Cigarette Shops
  • Alcohol, Wine, and Spirits Stores
  • CBD / Cannabis Dispensaries
  • Adult Content Sites
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Age Verification to configure your popup.
  4. Set your colors, text, logo, and choose the verification method.
  5. Save changes and you are done!
sections.faq:
Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin works perfectly on all pages, including WooCommerce shop, cart, and checkout pages. The Pro version offers even deeper integration like Soft Gating and Category restrictions.

Will this popup hurt my SEO?

No! Version 1.1.0 introduces a smart “Crawler Bypass” feature that prevents search engines (like Googlebot) from seeing the popup, ensuring your site gets indexed correctly.

Can I change the age limit from 18 to 21?

Yes! You can set a custom dynamic Minimum Age requirement directly in the General Settings tab.

Does this plugin support translations?

Yes, it is translation-ready and officially supports WPML, Polylang, and Loco Translate.

1.2.0

  • Major UX Update: Overhauled the admin sidebar with a modern SaaS layout, featuring a dedicated support widget and dynamic cross-sell grid.
  • UX Enhancement: Added a sticky “Save Changes” action button to the top header for faster workflow navigation.
  • Tweak: Redesigned the “Upgrade to Pro” card with unified premium purple styling and aesthetic branding.
  • Tweak: Restricted plugin admin notices strictly to the plugin’s own settings page to completely prevent dashboard clutter.
  • Tweak: Updated all documentation and resource links to point to the new, comprehensive knowledge base.

1.1.9

  • Major UI Update: Overhauled the entire admin dashboard with a modern, responsive, 1280px full-width SaaS layout.
  • Tweak: Added a sleek, horizontal scrollable mobile navigation menu for the settings tabs.
  • Tweak: Redesigned the “Upgrade to Pro” landing page and sidebar to perfectly align with modern design standards.
  • Tweak: Blocked intrusive third-party admin notices from cluttering the plugin settings page.

1.1.8

  • Tweak: Re-engineered the core to allow the Pro version to function as a 100% standalone, independent plugin.
  • Tweak: Added smart fallback logic to prevent accidental redirect loops when switching between verification methods and plugin licenses.
  • Tweak: Minor UI layout adjustments to support wider monitors in the settings panel.

1.1.7

  • New Feature: Added seamless AJAX settings saving. Your configuration now saves instantly without page reloads, accompanied by a modern premium toast notification.
  • Tweak: Completely redesigned the internal Pro landing page to match the clean, modern SaaS aesthetic of the settings dashboard.
  • Tweak: Removed the “Support Development” sidebar widget to provide a cleaner, distraction-free interface.
  • Tweak: Updated external links to open safely in new tabs.

1.1.6

  • Bug Fix: 100% Cache Compatibility! Moved the cookie check to client-side JavaScript so the popup works flawlessly with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, and Cloudflare out of the box.
  • Tweak: Maxed out the popup’s z-index to ensure it always sits on top of aggressive cookie banners and chat widgets.
  • New Feature: 100% WPML & Polylang Compatibility! Added a wpml-config.xml file and text domain loading so you can easily translate your custom admin settings (titles, buttons) directly from your String Translation dashboard.
  • Tweak: Added interactive “Feature Discovery” premium blur tabs to the settings panel to preview Pro capabilities.

1.1.5

  • Tweak: Reorganized the admin dashboard to move heavy Pro modules (Identity, Analytics, Compliance) into dedicated sidebar submenus for a much cleaner workspace.
  • Tweak: Optimized mobile responsiveness and added native internal scrolling for the popup UI on smaller screens (iPhone SE, etc.).
  • Pro: Added full architecture support for Strict Anti-Bypass Lockouts (Underage Honeypot), Frictionless Inline WooCommerce Checkout, and Secure Document Vault with Auto-Watermarking.

1.1.4

  • Bug Fix: Fixed a critical responsive layout issue on iOS (iPhone/Safari) where the Date of Birth calendar input would break out of its container and trigger unwanted screen auto-zooming.
  • Tweak: Streamlined the admin settings interface. When the Pro plugin is active, settings tabs intelligently merge into a unified “General” view for a cleaner workspace.
  • Pro: Added full architecture support for the new Manual KYC Identity Verification module (Global ID uploads, Admin Lightbox Review, HTML Emails, and Magic Link approvals).

1.1.3

  • New: Added an elegant “Get Pro” tab in the settings menu to showcase upcoming premium features.
  • New: Added quick “Settings” and “Upgrade to Pro” action links on the WordPress Plugins page.
  • Tweak: Added internal developer hooks (filters and actions) to allow future Pro extensibility.
  • Tweak: Updated frontend JavaScript to better handle cookie pathing in strictly cached environments.

1.1.2

  • Bug Fix: Added client-side cookie detection to fix popup re-appearing on cached pages.

1.1.1

  • Tweak: Added a “Review us on WordPress” request widget to the settings page sidebar.
  • Tweak: Optimized plugin repository assets (changed banner format from PNG to JPG for better performance).

1.1.0

  • Major UI Redesign: Added modern glassmorphism aesthetic and smooth CSS animations.
  • New Feature: Dynamic Minimum Age limit (e.g., 18, 21+).
  • New Feature: SEO Crawler Bypass (Googlebot friendly).
  • New Feature: Logged-in User Bypass.
  • New Feature: “Remember Me” checkbox for user cookie consent.
  • New Feature: Custom Color Pickers in the backend to match any theme.
  • Tweak: Replaced browser alerts with inline smooth error messages.
  • Tweak: Added native WordPress Media Uploader for the logo.
  • Tweak: Organized backend settings into clean navigational tabs.
  • Compatibility: Tested up to WordPress 7.1 and requires PHP 7.4.

1.0.1

  • Compatibility update for WordPress 7.0.
  • Increased minimum PHP requirement to 7.4.

1.0

  • Initial release.
